title: Configured route — inspecting the route's record and substituting its supplied state
titleEs: Ruta de recurso — Inspección y cambio de un dato
description: The generic room after the placeholder sheet travelled the route configured between abstract bodies (stations of the same size on one row, the numbered steps on the floor, the sheet in the last tray). On the board lies the route's record plate: the supplied route state, its glyph (● available / ◆ not checked) over a short route icon. A lens (a window with a rim, distinct from the panel) opens on the plate — a real enlarged copy of the same room coordinates — and one supplied datum is substituted: the route state. The old value is kept, unchanged, in a dock as "was"; the glyph and the icon change (labels hidden: only they show it); only the dependent state follows in the context: the route is drawn dashed (pending) and the sheet waits in the first tray while its dashed outline stays in the last. The context returns with a neutral changed-datum marker. Illustrative; nothing is evaluated; no rank, admissibility, time limit, ground or outcome; jurisdiction unspecified.
